proposal: Additions to tokens/tokens.json for the hybrid UI (design/hybrid-ui/spec.md). Not merged into tokens.json: radii and shape rules can go in when Scott approves the look; motion values go to Labs first (CLAUDE.md rule 3) and graduate here when settled. Colours: none new; the hybrid uses existing surface and text tokens only.

radius.note: keyPt is today's chiclet.radiusPt. sheetPt is new: sheet top corners and docked panels. Nested corners follow DESIGN.md (outer = inner + padding).

shape.note: Shape as state: the second channel beside colour (spec 1.1). Code reads these pairs, not numbers.

elevation.note: Unchanged. Menus, popups and the app strip use elevation 3 (held); sheets and docked panels elevation 1 (panel) with the sheet's upward shadow.

motion.reduceMotion: nothing travels or changes size; state changes and arrivals cross-fade at about 150 ms (DESIGN.md)
motion.compose: Compose spring: bounce 0.25 ≈ dampingRatio 0.75, bounce 0.2 ≈ 0.8; pick stiffness to land near the duration
